gate_b.random_removal.id_domain: the unit's member row ids, sorted
gate_b.random_removal.label: gate-b-random-removal-v1
gate_b.random_removal.named_in: Gate B sealed build (.ai/inputs/gate-b-sealed-20261008/build_sealed.py, 80cb8944); reused by brief rev 1 REQ-4 for d = 6-8
gate_b.random_removal.use: R_d for d = 6, 7, 8 through the frozen builder's own draw_r (loaded by path after its SHA-256 check); 75 rows per unit; draw d runs at seed 1100 + d

a1.ties.id_domain: all training row ids of the prepared set, sorted
a1.ties.label: stage1-a1-ties-v1
a1.ties.use: tie order of A1's top-600 removal (equal a_i)

a1_variants.ties.id_domain: all training row ids of the prepared set, sorted
a1_variants.ties.label: stage1-a1-variants-ties-v1
a1_variants.ties.named_in: registry, after the seal (W1 builder extract rev 2 W1-04; appended after the T1 commit 9525005)
a1_variants.ties.use: tie order of the report-only top-600 sets of the A1 variants q, e1 and adam (W1-04); never an arm

datashield.ties.id_domain: all training row ids of the prepared set, sorted
datashield.ties.label: stage1-datashield-ties-v1
datashield.ties.use: tie order of DataShield-style's top 600 (equal CSS)

h2a.fill.id_domain: the training rows that are not H2a rows, sorted
h2a.fill.label: stage1-h2a-fill-v1
h2a.fill.use: H2a when n < 600: all n H2a rows plus a sealed sample of 600 - n other rows

h2a.sample.label: stage1-h2a-sample-v1
h2a.sample.use: H2a when n >= 600: a sealed sample of 600 of the n H2a rows

l1.scan.id_domain: all training row ids of the prepared set, sorted
l1.scan.label: stage1-l1-scan-v1
l1.scan.use: the 64 Dolly dev prompts of L1's layer scan (a sealed sample of 64)

l1.ties.id_domain: all training row ids of the prepared set, sorted
l1.ties.label: stage1-l1-ties-v1
l1.ties.use: tie order of L1's top-600 removal (equal scores)

l8.control.id_domain: category c's rows outside octile k, sorted
l8.control.label: stage1-l8-control-v1
l8.control.use: octile k's category-matched random control: n_k,c rows of category c (c = that category's unit group id) from outside octile k

l8.control_fill.id_domain: category c's rows inside octile k, sorted
l8.control_fill.label: stage1-l8-control-fill-v1
l8.control_fill.use: the fill when n_k,c > |c| - n_k,c: 2 n_k,c - |c| rows of category c from inside octile k (never from another category)

length.order.id_domain: all training row ids of the prepared set, sorted
length.order.label: stage1-length-order-v1
length.order.use: the one length order (target tokens ascending, then this sealed rank): octile k = positions 600k to 600k + 599; H1 = octile 0; H2b = octile 7

plant.leaf.id_domain: the first in sealed_order(plant.leaf) over the cell ids of the candidate leaves; the candidates are the drawn unit's 37-row leaves with no oversize row, or, if there is none, its no-oversize leaves with the smallest |n − 37|
plant.leaf.label: stage1-plant-leaf-v1
plant.leaf.use: the planted M = 128 leaf (settings build_plant.json, draws.leaf, states the same rule)

plant.quarters.id_domain: all training row ids of the prepared set, sorted
plant.quarters.label: stage1-plant-quarters-v1
plant.quarters.use: the walk order inside each final quartile that places the M = 128 quarters

plant.quartile_ties.id_domain: all training row ids of the prepared set, sorted
plant.quartile_ties.label: stage1-plant-quartile-ties-v1
plant.quartile_ties.use: the tie order of the within-unit walk (target tokens ascending, then this sealed rank) that places the M = 32 quartiles

plant.r150.id_domain: the planted corpus's members of unit g (Dolly row ids and add- ids), sorted
plant.r150.label: stage1-plant-r150-v1
plant.r150.named_in: lead decisions addendum (b8a67719) section 3; parts (d, g): the builder's reading of 'the same per-unit stratification', confirmed by the lead (addendum section 4.2, 1d4e42a2)
plant.r150.use: R150 on the planted data, draw d (d = 1-3, at seed 1100 + d): per unit g a sealed sample of 18 or 19 rows (settings build_plant.json, r150)

plant.r150_units.label: stage1-plant-r150-units-v1
plant.r150_units.named_in: registry, after the seal: the builder's 6 x 19 + 2 x 18 allocation, confirmed by the lead (addendum section 4.2, 1d4e42a2)
plant.r150_units.use: R150 draw d: the sealed sample of the 6 units that give 19 rows (150 = 8 x 18 + 6)

plant.r600.id_domain: the planted corpus's members of unit g (Dolly row ids and add- ids), sorted
plant.r600.label: stage1-plant-r600-v1
plant.r600.named_in: lead decisions addendum (b8a67719) section 3; parts (d, g): the builder's reading of 'the same per-unit stratification', confirmed by the lead (addendum section 4.2, 1d4e42a2)
plant.r600.use: R600 on the planted data, draw d (d = 1-3, at seed 1100 + d): per unit g a sealed sample of 75 rows (Gate B's R rule)

plant.rows.label: stage1-plant-rows-v1
plant.rows.use: the sealed order of the plant candidates: the first 37 rows, and the first 75 for the pilot's one allowed raise

plant.unit.label: stage1-plant-unit-v1
plant.unit.use: the planted unit (first of the sealed order); never redrawn

random_removal.r1200.id_domain: the unit's member row ids, sorted
random_removal.r1200.label: stage1-random-removal-1200-v1
random_removal.r1200.use: R_1200 draw d (d = 2, 3, 4, at seed 1100 + d): per unit g a sealed sample of 150 rows (Gate B's R rule form)

random_removal.r2400.id_domain: the unit's member row ids, sorted
random_removal.r2400.label: stage1-random-removal-2400-v1
random_removal.r2400.use: R_2400 draw d (d = 2, 3, 4, at seed 1100 + d): per unit g a sealed sample of 300 rows (Gate B's R rule form)

s1.order.label: stage1-s1-v1
s1.order.use: S1 = the first 48 of the S-pool in this sealed order

s3.subset.label: stage1-s3-subset-v1
s3.subset.use: the S3 subset = the first 1,000 of the S-pool in this sealed order (overlap with S1 allowed and counted)

s3.ties.id_domain: the S3 subset's candidate ids that SAS scores (a y^orig that encode_train refuses leaves the ranking, lead decisions L14 (1)), sorted
s3.ties.label: stage1-s3-ties-v1
s3.ties.use: tie order of S3's top-48 add selection (equal SAS)

s4.order.id_domain: the S-pool candidate ids minus S1's, sorted
s4.order.label: stage1-s4-v1
s4.order.use: the S4 candidate list = the first 512 of (S-pool minus S1) in this sealed order

selector.diagnostic.id_domain: one replicate's standard-normal array, indexed by option (category menu) or by row (planted menus)
selector.diagnostic.label: stage1-selector-diagnostic-v1
selector.diagnostic.use: the diagnostic's score noise z (L15 (6)); shared by every grid point of one replicate (common random numbers)

selector.effects.label: stage1-selector-effects-v1
selector.effects.use: the true effects of one replicate's options under its (shape, size) grid point

selector.noise.id_domain: one replicate's standard-normal array, indexed by (option, seed index, phi, psi)
selector.noise.label: stage1-selector-noise-v1
selector.noise.use: trial observation noise; one fixed-shape array per replicate, so a key's draw never depends on the policy that asks (common random numbers, L15 (4))

selector.params.label: stage1-selector-params-v1
selector.params.use: the parameter draw per replicate (parameter uncertainty)

selector.plant.id_domain: the cell ids of one simulated planted menu
selector.plant.label: stage1-selector-plant-v1
selector.plant.use: the planted cell of a simulated planted menu

selector.psi.id_domain: the saved prompt labels of one (option, seed) unit
selector.psi.label: stage1-selector-psi-v1
selector.psi.use: the prompt subsample of a psi-trial replayed from saved labels

selector.sim2.label: stage1-selector-sim2-v1
selector.sim2.use: the report-only SIM2 point: the diagnostic picks the true best with probability 0.5

selector.ties.id_domain: the option ids of a menu other than keep, sorted
selector.ties.label: stage1-selector-ties-v1
selector.ties.use: the tie order among options other than keep (a tie with keep always goes to keep)

selector.uninformative.id_domain: the option ids of one replicate's menu other than keep
selector.uninformative.label: stage1-selector-uninformative-v1
selector.uninformative.use: the 'uninformative' diagnostic: a sealed random order (also used when s = 0)

selfinf_n.ties.id_domain: all training row ids of the prepared set, sorted
selfinf_n.ties.label: stage1-selfinf-n-ties-v1
selfinf_n.ties.use: tie order of Self-Inf-N-style's top 600 (equal scores)
